{{Quote|This is an alliance. There are no sides.|Asani, on the Eternal Alliance|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''</ref>}}
'''Asani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the [[Eternal Empire]]. Following the [[Battle of Asylum]] she traveled to [[Odessen]] and joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]]. Asani was assigned to the [[Military Operations|military branch]] of the Alliance under former Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Bey'wan Aygo]], where she frequently clashed with [[Private/Legends|Private]] [[Schor]] over their former affiliations. She was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during the [[Crisis on Umbara]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corporal Asani appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' in the [[Alliance base]] on Odessen.
